I screenshotted the whole canvas and looked at it. The five existing artboards (Changes, Save a version, Publish, Nothing to save, Publish rejected) look the same as before. That's expected, since I only added code for the new artboard and didn't change anything they use.

The new "Onboarding feedback" artboard sits in its own section below Publish and Nothing to save, with all 10 rows showing.

The board's own sticky notes and section labels ("Onboarding 0", "Pricing 0", "Export 0", "Ideas 0") are drawn over the canvas. Some cover the Changes artboard, and the "Pricing" label sits on top of the new artboard. That's the board drawn on top of the canvas, not part of the artboards. I left it alone because I didn't change the board.
